annotations.exact_quote: Partial label learning deals with the problem where each training instance is assigned a set of candidate labels, only one of which is correct.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将每个训练实例的监督设为候选标签集合且仅一个正确，符合偏标记学习的标准设定。

annotations.exact_quote: This paper provides the first attempt to leverage the idea of self-training for dealing with partially labeled examples. Specifically, we propose a unified formulation with proper constraints to train the desired model and perform pseudo-labeling jointly.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确采用自训练思路，并联合进行模型训练与伪标记，伪标记作为后续训练机制的一部分。
